xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3942: Per-skill on/off at global, project, and issue level

plan.title: Per-skill on/off at global, project, and issue level (rescoped from skill bundles)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every Overdeck-managed agent sees the whole synced skill corpus. Operators cannot choose which skills apply globally, per project, or per issue, so niche skills cost context in every session and cannot be switched off for one project or issue.
narratives.Proposal: Per-skill on/off overrides at three levels resolved issue > project > global > default on, with 11 core workflow skills always on. Global overrides live in ~/.overdeck/config.yaml skills.overrides, project overrides in projects.yaml skill_overrides, issue overrides in <planHome>/.pan/skill-overrides/<ISSUE>.yaml committed on main through the plan-artifact commit door. Generated launchers run a hidden `pan skills launch-settings` step (fail-open) that hides disabled skills by name: Claude Code via --settings skillOverrides 'off', Codex via [[skills.config]] enabled=false in the per-agent config.toml. Both mechanisms were verified live during planning. CLI `pan skills list|set`, dashboard API GET/PUT /api/skills/overrides, a shared SkillOverridesPanel on the Skills page (global), project settings (project), and issue view (issue), and a docs section in features/skills.mdx. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-3942.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Named or versioned skill bundles, bundle includes, digests, provenance reports (do not plan or file)
- Conversation-scope overrides
- Role/audience filtering (#1655)
- Git/registry skill sources
- Context-cost estimates
- Changing pan sync, ~/.claude/skills, ~/.agents/skills, workspace .claude/skills seeding, or any user-owned harness settings file
- Applying overrides to ohmypi, acp/opencode, kimi-code, muse, or remote (Fly) launches
- Changing or removing the GET /api/skills route
- Closing or superseding #1357, #1655, #1656
- Changing a live session's skill set; overrides apply at the next launch only
- Adding lines to ratcheted files over 1000 lines (projects.ts, settings-api.ts, schema.ts, src/cli/index.ts, spawn-prep.ts, spawn.ts, conversation-runtime.ts)

items.title: Add the skill-override resolver, core-skill list, and skill catalog

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-3942.md WI-1. Create resolve.ts (pure: CORE_SKILLS constant with exactly the 11 names from decision D4, isCoreSkill, resolveSkillStates, disabledSkillNames, the exported types SkillOverrideLevel/SkillStateSource/SkillOverrideMap/SkillOverrideLayers/SkillState) and catalog.ts (async listSkillCatalog over <home>/.overdeck/skills, <home>/.claude/skills, <home>/.agents/skills and optional <projectRoot>/.pan/skills; name = dir name; description = frontmatter description first line; dedupe first-found; sort by name; skip missing roots; fs/promises only; home injectable). Precedence: issue > project > global > default true; core skills always enabled with source 'core'. disabledSkillNames returns the sorted non-core names whose resolved value is false, including names absent from any catalog.

Given issue {grilling:false} and project {grilling:true}, When resolved, Then grilling returns enabled false with source 'issue'; a skill with no value anywhere returns enabled true with source 'default'
Given pan-done set to false at global, project, and issue, When resolved, Then pan-done returns enabled true, core true, source 'core' and disabledSkillNames excludes pan-done

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-3942.md WI-2. In src/lib/projects.ts add only the `export` keyword to `interface ProjectsConfigMutation<T>` (line ~617) and `async function updateProjectsConfigAsync` (line ~653); in src/lib/settings-api.ts add only `export` to `function runSettingsWriteSerialized` (line ~888). Create store.ts: readGlobalSkillOverrides/readProjectSkillOverrides/readIssueSkillOverrides/loadSkillOverrideLayers/issueSkillOverridesPath/parseSkillOverrideUpdate/setSkillOverride/SkillOverrideError exactly as specified. Global = ~/.overdeck/config.yaml key skills.overrides via yaml parseDocument setIn/deleteIn inside runSettingsWriteSerialized (comment-preserving). Project = projects.yaml projects.<key>.skill_overrides via updateProjectsConfigAsync. Issue = <planHome>/.pan/skill-overrides/<ISSUE>.yaml (format in PRD), then commitPlanArtifacts({cwd: planHome, paths:[file], message:'chore(workspace): skill overrides for <ISSUE>'}) and pushPlanArtifacts(planHome) when committed; delete the file when empty and commit the deletion. Validation: core -> 'core-skill', not in listSkillCatalog for the context -> 'unknown-skill', unregistered project -> 'unknown-project', issue with no owning project -> 'unknown-issue'; enabled:null always allowed for a stored non-core key. Async fs/git only (no execSync, no new sync config reads). Tests set a git committer identity and commit.gpgsign=false in temp repos, mirroring the existing plan-artifact-commit tests.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-3942.md WI-4. Replace the `pan skills` registration (src/cli/index.ts, search ".command('skills')") with the list (default) / set <skill> <state> / hidden launch-settings subcommands from the PRD. src/cli/index.ts is ratcheted at 1276 lines and must not grow: put the registration in registerSkillsCommands(program) exported from src/cli/commands/skills.ts and call it with one line. Implement skillsListCommand (table NAME STATE SOURCE DESCRIPTION or --json SkillState[]; --issue alone derives the project), skillsSetCommand (on|off|inherit -> true|false|null; --project with --issue exits 1; SkillOverrideError -> stderr + exit 1; print commit/push outcome), skillsLaunchSettingsCommand (claude-code prints claudeSkillSettingsJson to stdout; codex requires --codex-home and calls writeCodexSkillOverrides; other harness exits 2). Run npm run build, then npm run generate:slash-commands, then commit the regenerated file. Bare `pan skills --json` must keep working via isDefault; test it.

Create skill-overrides.ts in the meta.ts route style (HttpRouter.add, jsonResponse, exported RouteLayer) and add it to Layer.mergeAll in routes/misc.ts. narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-3942.md WI-7. Create SkillOverridesPanel({level, projectKey?, issueId?, enabled=true}) using useQuery(['skill-overrides', level, projectKey, issueId]) against GET /api/skills/overrides and PUT via fetch with dashboardMutationJsonHeaders, invalidating ['skill-overrides'] on success. Rows: name, description, control, effective on/off, source label. Global level = on/off switch (off sends false, on sends null). Project/issue = segmented Inherit|On|Off (null|true|false). Core rows disabled and labeled 'Core — always on'. Name filter box. Header note 'Changes apply to Claude Code and Codex agents at their next launch.' Show the error body on failure and 'Saved locally; push pending: <reason>' when pushed is false. SkillsList.tsx renders <SkillOverridesPanel level="global" />. Follow the pan-style-guide skill (Broadsheet; no pill badges; no decorative red/green).
